description: Status-question routing on the drone's Jetson Orin Nano. Gemma 4 E2B (Q4_0 GGUF), greedy decoding with a JSON-schema grammar, prompt clock fixed, 3 fresh-process runs per variant in alternating order, vision stream off. parse_ms = wall time of one parse call. readings_answered = what the variant's own routing would answer (recorded, nothing fetched). Model output text is not included. In the B vs C experiment both variants' readings use C's names (lock is reported as person_lock); in A vs B, A's old names are reported with today's (its motors = armed, its motor_power = motors).

platform.board: Jetson Orin Nano 8 GB developer kit

variants.A: four inspect_* actions, then keyword topics; keyword backups for GPS and battery
variants.B: one status action with a model-chosen fields list (16 names); code answers
variants.C: B with the lock field renamed person_lock (not adopted)

experiments.per_case_note: action and readings answered from run 1; identical in all 3 runs of each variant
